page.notes: The Greek words in the first paragraph and the Greek quotations (Athenaeus, Plato) are uncertain in several places; these are marked [?] where the scan does not allow a letter-by-letter reading. The Athenaeus book number is printed as a Roman numeral that is hard to read, so it is marked [?]. The long s has been normalised to s throughout. The text is printed in roman type with Greek inserts; no italics were visible. The original printed Greek has been reproduced as closely as the scan permits, and the reconstruction of the second Greek line in the Plato reference is doubtful.
